system.description:
You lean into the "assassin" half instead — Spellstrike is a tool for opening a fight on your terms, not sustaining one.

  • First Cut: If your target is unaware of you (surprised, or you have advantage from Stealth) when you Spellstrike, the target has Disadvantage on its save against that strike's spell. If a Levelled Spellstrike against an unaware target misses, the spell and its slot are not lost: you may deliver it with your next hit before the end of your next turn.
